'''House Antos''' is one of the known merchant [[House]]s of [[Arad Doman]].

The lord of the house is [[Yilvas Antos]]. He sought to expand his influence by marrying his daughter, [[Meka Antos|Meka]], to [[Lorwyn Kilvar]], the son of the ruling family of [[Ostin Falls]] on the border of [[Toman Head]] and [[Almoth Plain]]. The Antos House viewed Ostin Falls as a means to increase their access to raw materials, while also giving the house a new market for the manufactured goods that it traded in.<ref>''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
